cases.input: One support responsibility emits many files and file count is promoted to semantic object count.
A material handoff has no explicit preserved/lost/unknown dimensions and no purpose-scoped exchange requirement.
A one-directional reference derivative is rejected only because native round-trip authoring semantics are absent even though round-trip is not required.
Downstream import/edit capability is treated as source change authority and source-master ownership without an authority-transfer event.
An exchange derivative reopens successfully and that PASS promotes native authoring and professional design state; runtime delivery success is also used to claim native parametric preservation.
Round-trip acceptance uses byte hash only even though byte identity is not a controlled property.
A downstream deployment package is incomplete and the unchanged upstream source is globally invalidated; mixed per-role results are flattened without aggregation.
Unknown loss intersects required information yet handoff is accepted; another unknown dimension outside claim causes global HOLD.
File open/import success is treated as handoff PASS without required information readback; format/schema layer PASS auto-grants higher project/task/authority layers.
The same material loss is accepted across derivative and source-master roles without role scope, and exchange derivative silently replaces Source/Edit Master responsibility.

Mixed per-object information results are flattened to one PASS, fidelity is judged against total native-model equivalence instead of declared exchange requirements, and producer export validation substitutes for consumer readback.
An editable-master handoff requires round-trip but is accepted with unresolved round-trip, while an untested loss dimension is recorded as NONE.
